title: 第1章 魂穿斗罗第2章 偷出宗门
slug: 斗罗穿成宁荣荣的妹妹一路成神
content_zh:
各位读者朋友们，在看之前我先声明一下：
这本书之前是叫《斗罗之三生琉璃》，是2021年12月24日开始写起的，只是后面断更太多年，编辑让我重开一本，如果发现有别的文内容相似或者类似，请先对比一下两本书的发布时间，实在觉得我抄了的，就直接跟官方举报吧。
阳光从密密层层的枝叶间透射下来，地上印满大大小小的粼粼光斑。
宁苒苒开开心心的捧着刚刚抢到的斗罗大陆限量版卡片，一蹦一跳的走着。
“嘟嘟嘟——”
前方的马路上，一辆失控的货车在马路上奔驰。
而那货车前进的方向不远处，是一个八九岁的孩子，宁苒苒就站在那孩子的左上方。
显然那孩子已经吓傻了，站在原地不动弹，说时迟那时快，宁苒苒顾不上多想，身体本能跑向那孩子，将对方推离原地。
“碰——”
是重物落地的声音，万籁俱寂。
身下红色漫延，宁苒苒躺在冰凉的油柏路上，那盒她刚刚抢到的斗罗限定卡片随着她飞了出去，洋洋洒洒的卡片落满地，上面精致的人物倒映在眼中。
宁苒苒咧嘴一笑，心想：还真是好看呢！
可惜刚拿到手还没捂热……
接着眼前一黑失去意识。
谁都没有注意到，宁苒苒脖子上那条坠着架竖琴模样的项链在沾到她的血时，闪过一抹流光，转瞬即逝。
—————————分割线—————————
宁苒苒回复意识的那一刻正置身于黑暗中。
“我这是在地狱吗？这么黑！”
她想着，动了动手。
“啊呦……风致，你快看，宝宝他动了，他踢了我一下。”

一道温柔的女音传来。
“真的吗？快让我听听……”
宁苒苒：！
Σ（°△°|||）︴
我这是转世投胎了？不用喝孟婆汤的吗？
正在想着，刚刚那道温和的男声再次传来：“阿柔，医生说了，你怀的是双胞胎，可一定要好好保重自己。”
“你放心吧，只是我先天体弱，万一……”
“不要胡说，有医生在，还有骨叔和剑叔找回来的草药，一定不会让你有事，不要胡思乱想了。
乖……”
这次温和的男声带了点严肃。
“好吧！”
……
宁苒苒心想，这就是我的爸爸妈妈吗？看起来他们都是很温柔的人呢！
我也有爸爸妈妈了……真好！
不过宁苒苒终究还只是一个胎儿，很快她就沉沉睡去，短时间内不可能会再醒来了。
睡着前，宁苒苒回顾了一下自己短暂的一生，还真是够戏剧化的。
身为孤儿，小小年纪就要无奈的为生活学费所奔波。
大一那年却被告知她是京都三大家族的宁家遗落在外的女儿。

The sun shines through the dense layers of branches and leaves, and the ground is filled with large and small sparkling light spots.
Ning Ranran happily held the Douluo Continent limited edition card she had just grabbed and jumped up and down.
"Dududu——"
On the road ahead, an out-of-control truck was racing on the road.
Not far from the direction of the truck, there was an eight or nine-year-old child, and Ning Ranran was standing on the upper left side of the child.
Obviously the child was frightened and stood still. It was so late and so fast that Ning Ranran couldn't think about it. Her body instinctively ran towards the child and pushed him away from the place.
"Touch——"
It was the sound of heavy objects falling to the ground, and everything was completely silent.
With red spreading all over her body, Ning Ranran was lying on the cold asphalt road. The box of Douluo limited cards she just grabbed flew out with her, and the cards fell all over the ground, and the exquisite characters on them were reflected in her eyes.
Ning Ranran grinned and thought to herself: It's really pretty!
It's a pity that I haven't warmed it up since I just got it...
Then his vision went dark and he lost consciousness.
No one noticed that the necklace with a harp hanging around Ning Ranran's neck flashed a flash of light when it was stained with her blood, and it disappeared in an instant.
————————Dividing line——————————
The moment Ning Ranran regained consciousness, she was in darkness.
"Am I in hell? It's so dark!"
She thought and moved her hands.
"Ah... Fengzhi, look, the baby moved and kicked me."
A gentle female voice came.
"Really? Let me hear it quickly..."
Ning Ranran:!
Σ（°△°|||）︴
Am I reincarnated? Don’t you need to drink Meng Po soup?
While he was thinking about it, the gentle male voice just now came again: "Arou, the doctor said that you are pregnant with twins, but you must take good care of yourself."
"Don't worry, it's just that I'm naturally weak. What if..."
"Don't talk nonsense. The doctor is here, and the herbs Uncle Gu and Uncle Jian have recovered will definitely not cause anything to happen to you. Don't think too much.
Be good..."
This time the gentle male voice was a little more serious.
"Okay!"
…
Ning Ranran thought to herself, are these my parents? They seem to be very gentle people!
I also have a father and a mother...it's great!
But Ning Ranran was still just a fetus after all. She fell into a deep sleep soon and was unlikely to wake up again in a short time.
Before falling asleep, Ning Ranran reviewed her short life, which was quite dramatic.
As an orphan, he had no choice but to pay for living expenses at a young age.
During her freshman year, she was told that she was the missing daughter of the Ning family, one of the three largest families in Kyoto.
